question: In 1961-62, Elgin Baylor was on Army Reserve duty at Fort Lewis, Washington, playing only on weekend passes with no practices. In his 48 games for the Lakers, what was his scoring average?
question_short: Elgin Baylor played 48 games on Army weekend passes, no practice. What was his scoring average?
answer_detail: Stationed at Fort Lewis, Baylor flew in on weekend passes and still put up 38.3 points and 18.6 rebounds a game. In the Finals he scored 61 on Boston in Game 5, still a Finals record.
answer_short: On weekend passes from the Army, Baylor averaged 38.3 points and 18.6 rebounds in 1961-62.
